topbar.tryPageOrAction: Try a page or action name

settings.title: System Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure how your community looks, who can join, and how it behaves. Changes apply instantly.

general.title: General
general.desc: Identity and locale for your community.

features.title: Site & features
features.desc: Turn core sections on or off and choose what the homepage shows. Disabling a section hides it everywhere and returns 404 — your data is kept and restored when you re-enable it.

maintenance.title: Maintenance mode
maintenance.desc: Take the site offline for everyone except a chosen group — and tell visitors what's happening.

login.title: Login
login.desc: How members sign in, and failed-attempt protection.

siteName.label: Site name
siteName.desc: Shown in the header, page titles, and emails.

featuresArticles.label: Articles
featuresArticles.desc: The CMS / blog section. When off, /articles and its API return 404.

featuresHome.label: Home feed
featuresHome.desc: The signed-in home feed at the site root. When off, the root redirects to your landing page.

featuresMembers.label: Members directory
featuresMembers.desc: The public members list. When off, /members returns 404 (profiles stay reachable).

landing.label: Landing page
landing.desc: Where the site root (/) sends visitors. Only enabled sections and installed plugins appear here.

siteUrl.label: Site URL
siteUrl.desc: The canonical address members reach you at.

siteDescription.label: Site description
siteDescription.desc: A short tagline used for SEO and social cards.

defaultLanguage.label: Default language
defaultLanguage.desc: Used for new members and anonymous visitors.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.desc: Server timezone for timestamps and scheduling.

registrationMode.label: Registration mode
registrationMode.desc: Who is allowed to create an account.

emailVerification.label: Email verification
emailVerification.desc: Require members to confirm their email before posting.

defaultGroup.label: Default user group
defaultGroup.desc: Group assigned to every new member.

allowComments.label: Allow article comments
allowComments.desc: Let members comment on published articles.

approveComments.label: Require comment approval
approveComments.desc: Hold new comments in a queue for a moderator.

perPage.label: Articles per page
perPage.desc: How many articles to show in listings.

showHot.label: Show 'Hot threads'
showHot.desc: Surface trending forum threads in the right rail.

hofRank.label: Hall of Fame ranking
hofRank.desc: The metric the leaderboard is sorted by.

smtpHost.label: SMTP host
smtpHost.desc: The mail server used to send notifications.

fromAddress.label: From address
fromAddress.desc: The sender shown on outgoing mail.

loginMethod.label: Login identifier
loginMethod.desc: Whether members sign in with their email, username, or either.

lockoutEnabled.label: Lock out after failed attempts
lockoutEnabled.desc: Temporarily block sign-in after too many failed attempts from repeated tries.

lockoutMaxAttempts.label: Max failed attempts
lockoutMaxAttempts.desc: Failed attempts allowed before the account is temporarily locked.

lockoutDuration.label: Lockout duration (minutes)
lockoutDuration.desc: How long sign-in stays blocked once the limit is hit.

collectName.label: Collect a name at registration
collectName.desc: Ask new members for a display name (e.g. their full name) shown on their profile.

nameRequired.label: Require the name
nameRequired.desc: Make the name mandatory during registration (only when collecting a name).

showPreviousUsernames.label: Show former usernames
showPreviousUsernames.desc: Display a member’s recent previous usernames on their profile. Members cannot hide this.

previousUsernameDays.label: Former-username window (days)
previousUsernameDays.desc: How long a former username stays visible after a change. 0 = show all history.

smtpUser.label: SMTP username
smtpUser.desc: Leave empty when relaying through a local mail server that needs no login.

smtpPass.label: SMTP password
smtpPass.desc: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Leave empty for an unauthenticated local relay.

smtpSecure.label: Implicit TLS
smtpSecure.desc: On for port 465. Leave off for 587, which upgrades the connection with STARTTLS.

fromName.label: From name
fromName.desc: Display name shown beside the sender address.

regMode.invite: Invite only — requires an invite code

master.label: Maintenance mode
master.desc: Everyone outside the allowed groups sees the maintenance screen. Admins always get through.

allowedGroups.label: Allowed groups
allowedGroups.desc: These groups can sign in and use the site while maintenance is on.
allowedGroups.adminLocked: Administrators always have access during maintenance.

headline.label: Headline
headline.desc: The large heading on the maintenance screen.

reason.label: Reason
reason.desc: A short, human explanation of why the site is down.
reason.placeholder: We're making the community better. We'll be back shortly.

mode.label: How progress is shown
mode.desc: Named steps read better for long work; a bar is fine for a quick job.

steps.label: Steps
steps.desc: Name each stage of the work. Mark the one you're on — visitors see it live.

bar.label: Bar label & fill
bar.desc: Text beside the bar, and how full it is (0–100). At 0 the bar is hidden.

eta.label: Back online (ETA)
eta.desc: Drives the countdown and the “back online” time. Leave empty to hide both.

countdown.label: Live countdown
countdown.desc: Show hours / minutes / seconds ticking down to the ETA.

autoRefresh.label: Auto-refresh when back
autoRefresh.desc: Visitors land on the site the moment maintenance ends — no reload needed.

background.label: Background
background.desc: Both follow your site's accent colours.

services.label: Affected services
services.desc: Listed on the maintenance screen. Click a status chip to cycle it.

links.label: Where to follow updates
links.desc: Shown as small icon links in the footer of the maintenance screen.

staffLink.label: Staff sign-in link
staffLink.desc: A discreet link in the footer opens the sign-in panel. Hide it and staff use /login directly.

invite.title: Invite Codes
invite.subtitle: Generate single-use codes to share with users you want to invite.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: Your installation at a glance — version, stack, live health, and where to get help.

migrations.title: Migration History
migrations.emptyHint: Recorded when the installer applies database migrations or the @xentium/migrate CLI imports a community from another platform.

XEC-API-4001.desc: The request body, query params, or route params failed Zod validation.
XEC-API-4001.cause: Malformed or missing fields in the request.
XEC-API-4001.fix: Check that all required fields are present and match the expected types.

XEC-API-4003.desc: The authenticated user does not have permission to perform this action.
XEC-API-4003.cause: Missing permission key for the requested resource.
XEC-API-4003.fix: Ensure the user's group has the required permission assigned in ACP → Access Control → Permissions.

XEC-API-4004.desc: The requested resource does not exist.
XEC-API-4004.cause: Invalid ID in the URL, or the resource was deleted.
XEC-API-4004.fix: Verify the resource ID. If recently deleted, this is expected.

XEC-API-4009.desc: The request conflicts with the current state of the resource.
XEC-API-4009.cause: The resource was changed by someone else, or the action was already performed (e.g. duplicate create).
XEC-API-4009.fix: Reload the page to get the current state, then retry the action.

XEC-API-4290.desc: Too many requests from this IP or user in the configured time window.
XEC-API-4290.cause: Automated traffic, bots, or a burst of legitimate requests.
XEC-API-4290.fix: Wait for the Retry-After period indicated in the response header, then retry.

XEC-API-5000.desc: An unexpected error occurred on the server.
XEC-API-5000.cause: Unhandled exception in application code. Check the Error Log for a stack trace.
XEC-API-5000.fix: Check ACP → System → Error Log. Report to the maintainer if persistent.

XEC-AUTH-1001.desc: Login failed — no account matched the provided credentials.
XEC-AUTH-1001.fix: Double-check credentials. Use Forgot Password if needed.

XEC-AUTH-1002.desc: The access token has expired and could not be refreshed.
XEC-AUTH-1002.cause: Refresh token expired or was revoked.
XEC-AUTH-1002.fix: Log in again to start a new session.

XEC-AUTH-1003.cause: A moderator or the threshold engine issued a temporary ban.
XEC-AUTH-1003.fix: Wait for the ban to expire, or appeal to a moderator.

XEC-AUTH-1004.cause: A moderator issued a permanent ban.
XEC-AUTH-1004.fix: Contact a site administrator to appeal.

XEC-AUTH-1005.desc: This action requires a verified email address.
XEC-AUTH-1005.cause: The user registered but has not clicked the verification link.
XEC-AUTH-1005.fix: Send a new verification email from Account Settings → Security.

XEC-AUTH-1006.desc: The chosen password does not meet the site's password requirements.
XEC-AUTH-1006.cause: Password is too short or missing required character types.
XEC-AUTH-1006.fix: Choose a password that meets the policy shown in ACP → System → Settings → Auth.

XEC-AUTH-2001.desc: Registration failed — the email address is already registered.
XEC-AUTH-2001.cause: An account with this email already exists.
XEC-AUTH-2001.fix: Use a different email, or log in if this is your account.

XEC-AUTH-2002.desc: Registration or rename failed — the username is already in use.
XEC-AUTH-2002.cause: Another user holds this username, or it appears in username history.

XEC-AUTH-2003.desc: The email verification or password reset token is invalid or has expired.
XEC-AUTH-2003.cause: Token was already used, has expired (15 min for reset, 24 h for verify), or was tampered with.
XEC-AUTH-2003.fix: Request a new email from the relevant form.

XEC-AUTH-1007.desc: The password reset token is invalid, already used, or expired.
XEC-AUTH-1007.cause: Reset links are single-use and expire 15 minutes after being issued.
XEC-AUTH-1007.fix: Request a new reset link from the Forgot Password page.

XEC-PERM-1001.desc: The user lacks the specific permission key required for this action.
XEC-PERM-1001.cause: Group assignment or permission matrix does not include this key.
XEC-PERM-1001.fix: Grant the required permission to the user's group in ACP → Access Control → Permissions.

XEC-PERM-1040.desc: The post or article body exceeds the maximum length for this user's level.
XEC-PERM-1040.cause: Group progression config restricts content length at this level.
XEC-PERM-1040.fix: Shorten the content, or adjust the group's max post length in ACP → Access Control → Groups → Progression.

XEC-PERM-1041.desc: The user has reached their daily post limit.
XEC-PERM-1041.cause: Group progression config sets a daily post cap.
XEC-PERM-1041.fix: Wait until midnight (UTC), or raise the limit in ACP → Access Control → Groups → Progression.

XEC-PERM-1042.desc: Too many attachments on this post.
XEC-PERM-1042.cause: Group progression config restricts attachment count.
XEC-PERM-1042.fix: Reduce attachments, or raise the limit in the group's progression config.

XEC-ARTICLE-3001.desc: The requested article does not exist or has been deleted.
XEC-ARTICLE-3001.cause: Invalid slug or ID, or article was soft-deleted.
XEC-ARTICLE-3001.fix: Verify the URL. If recently deleted, this is expected.

XEC-ARTICLE-3002.desc: The article exists but is not in a published state.
XEC-ARTICLE-3002.cause: Article is a draft or under review.
XEC-ARTICLE-3002.fix: Publish the article from the editor, or check the status in ACP → Content → Articles.

XEC-ARTICLE-3003.desc: The chosen URL slug is already used by another article.
XEC-ARTICLE-3003.cause: Duplicate title or manually set slug.
XEC-ARTICLE-3003.fix: Change the title or set a unique slug in the article editor.

XEC-STORE-7001.desc: The uploaded file exceeds the maximum allowed size for this upload type.
XEC-STORE-7001.cause: File size exceeds the limit defined in UPLOAD_LIMITS config.
XEC-STORE-7001.fix: Compress or resize the file, or increase the limit in the server config.

XEC-STORE-7002.desc: The file type is not allowed for this upload slot or user level.
XEC-STORE-7002.cause: MIME type check failed, or group progression config restricts this type.
XEC-STORE-7002.fix: Use an allowed file type. Admins can adjust group-level type restrictions in Progression config.

XEC-STORE-7003.desc: The file's magic bytes don't match the declared Content-Type.
XEC-STORE-7003.cause: File was renamed to appear as a different type.
XEC-STORE-7003.fix: Upload the correct file. Do not rename files to bypass type checks.

XEC-STORE-7004.desc: The requested storage path is outside the allowed public directories.
XEC-STORE-7004.cause: Attempt to access a private storage path (plugins/, themes/packs/, temp/) directly.
XEC-STORE-7004.fix: Access plugin or style pack files through their authenticated API endpoints.

XEC-PLUGIN-2001.desc: The uploaded plugin package is missing required manifest.json fields.
XEC-PLUGIN-2001.cause: Plugin was built with an outdated SDK or has a malformed manifest.
XEC-PLUGIN-2001.fix: Check manifest.json against the current plugin manifest schema. Required fields: id, name, version, vendor, minXentiumVersion.

XEC-PLUGIN-2002.desc: The uploaded .xtplugin file is not a valid plugin package.
XEC-PLUGIN-2002.cause: Not a ZIP archive, an unsafe (path-traversal) entry, or manifest.json is missing / not valid JSON.
XEC-PLUGIN-2002.fix: Re-download the package from its source. If self-built, rebuild it with the plugin SDK packager.

XEC-PLUGIN-2003.desc: A plugin with this id is already installed on this site.
XEC-PLUGIN-2003.cause: The package was uploaded twice, or an update was attempted through the install flow.
XEC-PLUGIN-2003.fix: Uninstall the existing plugin first, or use the update flow in ACP → Extensions → Installed.

XEC-PLUGIN-2004.desc: An update or management action targeted a plugin that is not installed on this site.
XEC-PLUGIN-2004.cause: The plugin was uninstalled, or the request named the wrong plugin id.
XEC-PLUGIN-2004.fix: Install the plugin first from ACP → Extensions → Marketplace, then retry.

XEC-PLUGIN-2005.desc: The update package version is not newer than the installed version.
XEC-PLUGIN-2005.cause: Updates are forward-only; the package version is the same as or older than what is installed.
XEC-PLUGIN-2005.fix: No action needed — the installed version is already current.

XEC-PLUGIN-2006.desc: Manual .xtplugin uploads are switched off on this site.
XEC-PLUGIN-2006.cause: The marketplace is the sanctioned install channel; manual uploads are off by default.
XEC-PLUGIN-2006.fix: Install from ACP → Extensions → Marketplace, or enable manual uploads on ACP → Extensions → Installed.

XEC-PLUGIN-2010.desc: A plugin migration file contains non-DDL SQL statements.
XEC-PLUGIN-2010.cause: The plugin's migration files include INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/SELECT — only DDL is allowed.
XEC-PLUGIN-2010.fix: Contact the plugin vendor. Migration files must only use CREATE/ALTER/DROP TABLE/INDEX statements.

XEC-PLUGIN-2011.desc: A migration listed in the manifest has no matching .up.sql / .down.sql file in the package.
XEC-PLUGIN-2011.cause: The package was built incompletely — every up migration must ship a matching down migration.
XEC-PLUGIN-2011.fix: Contact the plugin vendor for a correctly packaged build.

XEC-PLUGIN-2012.desc: An already-applied migration file differs from the one recorded at install time.
XEC-PLUGIN-2012.cause: The plugin package ships a modified version of a migration this site already ran.
XEC-PLUGIN-2012.fix: Do not edit applied migrations. The vendor must ship schema changes as a NEW migration in the next version.

XEC-PLUGIN-2013.desc: A plugin migration tries to create, alter, or drop a database object that is either a reserved core object or does not match the plugin's declared table prefix.
XEC-PLUGIN-2013.cause: The migration names an object beginning xcf_, xentium_, _prisma, pg_, or information_schema, or (when the plugin declares a tablePrefix) an object that omits that prefix.
XEC-PLUGIN-2013.fix: Namespace every table, index, sequence, type, function, and trigger with the plugin's own prefix, and never touch core-owned objects.

XEC-PLUGIN-2020.desc: The requested plugin route is not available.
XEC-PLUGIN-2020.cause: Plugin is installed but currently disabled.
XEC-PLUGIN-2020.fix: Enable the plugin in ACP → Extensions → Installed.

XEC-PLUGIN-2030.desc: The plugin's supported Xentium version range does not include this platform version.
XEC-PLUGIN-2030.cause: The manifest's minXentiumVersion is newer than this installation, or maxXentiumVersion is older.
XEC-PLUGIN-2030.fix: Update Xentium, or install a plugin version built for this platform version.

XEC-CORE-8001.desc: The requested theme is not registered in the ThemeRegistry.
XEC-CORE-8001.cause: Theme ID does not match any registered theme.
XEC-CORE-8001.fix: Re-enable the theme or upload its package again.

XEC-CORE-8002.desc: The uploaded .xttheme failed validation — the message names the file and the rule it broke.
XEC-CORE-8002.cause: A missing or malformed manifest.json, a layout that is not a valid document, a stylesheet containing rules other than :root custom properties, or an asset that is not an allowed type.
XEC-CORE-8002.fix: Read the message: it names the offending file. Validation is all-or-nothing, so nothing was applied and the site is unchanged.

XEC-CORE-8010.desc: The site is in maintenance mode and the requester is not in the allowed bypass group. This is an intentional state, not a fault — every blocked request returns this code, so it is NOT written to the Error Log (that would flood it). Enabling/disabling maintenance is recorded in the Activity Log.
XEC-CORE-8010.cause: An admin turned on maintenance mode (ACP → System → Settings → Maintenance). Only the configured allowed group and admins can bypass it.
XEC-CORE-8010.fix: To restore the site, disable maintenance mode in ACP → System → Settings. Staff can sign in on the maintenance screen to bypass it.

XEC-PAGE-3501.desc: The requested custom page does not exist.
XEC-PAGE-3501.cause: The page slug is wrong, or the page was deleted/unpublished.
XEC-PAGE-3501.fix: Check the slug in ACP → Content → Pages, or create the page.

XEC-PAGE-3502.desc: Another page already uses this slug.
XEC-PAGE-3502.cause: Slugs must be unique; the chosen slug collides with an existing page.
XEC-PAGE-3502.fix: Choose a different slug for the page in ACP → Content → Pages.

XEC-QUEUE-5000.desc: A background (BullMQ) job threw an error and failed after exhausting all retries. This is a wrapper code — it tells you a job died, not why.
XEC-QUEUE-5000.cause: The real cause is in THIS Error Log entry's own fields: read the message (e.g. a Prisma/SQL error, a network failure, or a job bug) and the context (queue, jobName, jobId). The XEC code is only the category.
XEC-QUEUE-5000.fix: Open the matching Error Log entry, read its message + context, and fix the underlying cause. Restart the worker process so it picks up the fix; the job re-runs on its next schedule. If the message points to an application bug, report it to the maintainer verbatim.

XEC-QUEUE-5001.desc: A schedule submitted in ACP → System → Scheduled Tasks was rejected.
XEC-QUEUE-5001.cause: The cron expression was malformed, or the schedule would fire more often than the job's minimum interval.
XEC-QUEUE-5001.fix: Use a valid 5-field cron expression, or choose a less frequent interval. The rejected schedule is not saved.

XEC-LICENSE-9001.desc: No valid entitlement exists for this plugin.
XEC-LICENSE-9001.cause: The plugin requires a license but none is activated for this site.
XEC-LICENSE-9001.fix: Activate a license in ACP → Extensions → License, or connect a marketplace account.

XEC-LICENSE-9002.desc: The entitlement is past expiry and the grace period has elapsed.
XEC-LICENSE-9002.cause: The license lapsed and the 30-day offline grace window ended.
XEC-LICENSE-9002.fix: Refresh or renew the license in ACP → Extensions → License. Already-enabled plugins keep running.

XEC-LICENSE-9003.desc: The entitlement is bound to a different domain than this site (production only).
XEC-LICENSE-9003.cause: The site's canonical URL (site.url) host differs from the domain the license was activated for.
XEC-LICENSE-9003.fix: Re-bind the license to this domain, or activate on the correct domain.

XEC-LICENSE-9004.desc: The download gate found no free production activation slot for this purchase.
XEC-LICENSE-9004.cause: All licensed production domains for this purchase are already in use.
XEC-LICENSE-9004.fix: Free a slot, or buy an additional domain on xentium.org.

XEC-LICENSE-9005.desc: This action needs a connected marketplace account.
XEC-LICENSE-9005.cause: No xentium.org account is connected for this site.
XEC-LICENSE-9005.fix: Connect an account in ACP → Extensions → Marketplace, or use a manual license key.

XEC-LICENSE-9006.desc: The stored entitlement JWT failed RS256 verification.
XEC-LICENSE-9006.cause: The token was tampered with, or the verifying public key does not match the issuer.
XEC-LICENSE-9006.fix: Re-activate the license. In production, confirm the bundled license public key matches xentium.org's signing key.

XEC-LICENSE-9007.desc: The marketplace / license server could not be reached.
XEC-LICENSE-9007.cause: Network failure or the license server is down. The 30-day grace period applies.
XEC-LICENSE-9007.fix: Check connectivity. Running plugins are unaffected during the grace window; retry later.

XEC-LICENSE-9008.desc: Activation was refused because this site already has an active license.
XEC-LICENSE-9008.cause: A second key was entered (or account auto-activation ran) while a license is active.
XEC-LICENSE-9008.fix: Deactivate the current license in ACP → Extensions → License first, then activate the new one.

XEC-LICENSE-9009.desc: The license server rejected the request — the message carries the exact reason.
XEC-LICENSE-9009.cause: Unknown or revoked key, ended license term, no free domain slot, or the license is bound to another domain.
XEC-LICENSE-9009.fix: Read the message: renew the term, free/add a domain slot, or contact marketplace support to move the binding.

XEC-LICENSE-9010.desc: This instance has no install record, so it has no identity to license.
XEC-LICENSE-9010.cause: The installer never finished, or the xcf_installs row was deleted from the database.
XEC-LICENSE-9010.fix: Complete the installer. If the install is otherwise healthy, restore the xcf_installs row from a backup — its siteId is what every license is bound to.

scheduled.title: Scheduled Tasks
scheduled.subtitle: Control when each recurring background job runs. Changes apply immediately — no restart needed. Disabling a task removes it from the scheduler; "Run now" triggers it once for testing.

tasks.title: Custom tasks
tasks.subtitle: Tasks you create yourself: pick a maintenance action, give it a schedule, and it runs unattended. Actions come from a fixed catalogue — a task can never run arbitrary code.
tasks.dialogHint: The task runs on its own schedule once saved. Use a dry run first to see what it would change.

tasks.destructiveWarn: This action can destroy data. Run it as a dry run first and check the result before scheduling it for real.
tasks.minInterval: Cannot run more often than every {{n}} min.
tasks.dryRunHint: Every run only reports what it would change and writes nothing.
tasks.paramsUnsupported: This action's parameters cannot be edited here. It will run with its defaults.
tasks.noRuns: This task has not run yet.
tasks.confirmDelete: "{{name}}" will be removed from the scheduler and its run history deleted. This cannot be undone.

license.entitlementsHint: What the signed entitlement currently grants this install. Your account may own more — see above.

hero.noLicencesSub: Your account is linked to this install. Anything you buy activates here automatically, with nothing to enter.
hero.disconnectedSub: The core keeps running, without a time limit. To use paid plugins, connect your marketplace account on the right — the licence activates by itself.
hero.expiredSub: Installed plugins keep running. New installs and updates are blocked until the licence is renewed.
hero.expiredHint: Renew in the marketplace, then refresh entitlements here — nothing has to be reissued.
hero.activeSub: Activated through your marketplace account on {{date}}. The binding follows this install, not the domain.
hero.activatedOn: Activated through your marketplace account on {{date}}.
hero.expiringHint: After it expires, installed plugins keep running, but updates and new installs are locked.
hero.offlineHint: The marketplace can't be reached right now. What you see is the last verified, signed entitlement — nothing is locked.

license.connectHint: Get a code: Account → Overview → Generate a code.
license.linkHint: Opens the marketplace so you can approve this install. Every licence you own activates here.
license.linkCodeLabel: Check this code matches the approval screen
license.linkWaiting: Waiting for you to approve it…
license.linkDenied: That connection was refused. Nothing was connected.
license.linkExpired: That connection attempt expired. Start a new one.
license.railNote: The check runs automatically every 24 hours. You only need to do it by hand right after buying something.

articles.deleteText: “{{title}}” will be soft-deleted and removed from public listings.

pages.deleteText: “{{title}}” will be permanently deleted, along with any nav links pointing to it.
pages.navHint: Choose where this page links from. Fine-tune order and labels under Appearance → Navigation.
pages.slotHint: Assign this page to a well-known slot. Slotted pages appear in the footer and power features like the registration terms link.

navigation.reorderHint: Drag the grip handle to reorder navigation links.
navigation.coreNoDelete: Core links cannot be deleted — deactivate them instead
navigation.removeText: “{{label}}” will be removed from the navigation.

categories.title: Article Categories
categories.name: Name
categories.empty: No categories yet. Create one to get started.
categories.deleteTextChildren: “{{name}}” has {{count}} subcategory(ies). They will be moved up one level.

progression.onLadderDesc: Enable auto-promotion for users in this group
progression.ladderPosHint: 1 = entry level. Drag to reorder on the ladder page.
progression.gEnabledDesc: Users are automatically promoted when thresholds are met
progression.gNotifyDesc: Send an in-app notification when a user is promoted
progression.gBarDesc: Display progression progress on public user profiles
progression.thresholdLogicDesc: How multiple thresholds are evaluated for promotion
progression.ladderHint: Drag to reorder · Users are promoted in ascending position order
progression.ladderEmpty: No groups on the progression ladder yet. Add groups below.

userDetail.activateText: {{name}} will be able to log in again.
userDetail.deactivateText: {{name}} will be unable to log in.
userDetail.liftBanText: {{name}}'s active ban will be removed and they will be able to log in.
userDetail.logoutText: All of {{name}}'s active sessions will be revoked. They will need to sign in again on every device.
userDetail.resetText: A password reset email will be sent to {{email}}. The link expires in 15 minutes.
userDetail.protectedSelf: You cannot perform this action on your own account
userDetail.protectedAdmin: Administrator accounts cannot be managed via the admin panel
userDetail.resetHint: Email this user a password reset link
userDetail.logoutHint: Revoke all of this user's sessions
userDetail.cannotDeactivateSelf: You cannot deactivate your own account
userDetail.selfDesc: Deactivation and banning are disabled to prevent lockout.
userDetail.badgeGrantHint: Granted badges stay until you take them back.
userDetail.badgeEarnedHint: Granted automatically for meeting this badge's requirements. Revoking it only lasts until the next sweep if they still qualify.

styleEditor.editEvery: Editing every instance of this component.
styleEditor.editOnly: Editing only {{region}} instances — overrides the global value inside that region.
styleEditor.toastDraft: Draft saved — publish to apply it live.
styleEditor.toastPublished: Published — your changes are now live for everyone.
styleEditor.toastReset: Appearance reset — inheriting the core design.
styleEditor.resetTitle: Reset appearance to the core design?
styleEditor.resetText: Restores the default theme tokens and fonts, and clears your custom CSS for both light and dark. This cannot be undone.
styleEditor.publishHint: Apply staged changes to the live site now
styleEditor.logoText: Logo Text (fallback when no image is set)
styleEditor.navbarLogoHint: PNG, SVG or WebP · max 2 MB · recommended 160×40 px
styleEditor.faviconHint: PNG, ICO or SVG · max 2 MB · recommended 64×64 px
styleEditor.cssIntro: Raw CSS for the theme you're viewing — scoped & applied after the tokens so it overrides any rule. Switch your theme with the top-bar toggle to edit the other one. Edits preview live; Apply & Save stores both themes and pushes them to every visitor.
styleEditor.cssThemeLayer: An installed theme also ships a stylesheet. It is applied before this one, so your rules here win — and nothing you write is overwritten when the theme updates.
styleEditor.sampleInfo: Info — a background job has started.
styleEditor.sampleError: Error — the server rejected the request.
styleEditor.toastsUse: Toasts use these feedback colours — edits above preview live on the fired samples.
styleEditor.forceState: Force this state on the specimen
styleEditor.fontScope: Applies site-wide, to body text and headings. The admin panel stays on Poppins.
styleEditor.clickToEdit: Click any surface to edit it
styleEditor.logoTextHint: Shown when no navbar logo is uploaded.
styleEditor.badType: That file type is not accepted here.
styleEditor.cssShadowBody: Custom CSS is applied after every token, so these declarations decide the value — not the rows in the inspector.
styleEditor.cssShadowNone: No :root variables here yet — nothing is overriding the editor.
styleEditor.shRawNote: This shadow has more than these controls can describe, so it is edited as text. Pick a preset or Custom to replace it.
styleEditor.iconKitHint: Paste your kit id, or its full https://kit.fontawesome.com/… URL. Leave empty to use the bundled free icons.
styleEditor.iconKitLicence: Uses your own FontAwesome subscription, on this site only. Xentium ships the free set; a kit adds the Pro icons your licence covers.
styleEditor.toastIconKit: Icon kit saved. Reload to see Pro icons.
styleEditor.iconKitInvalid: That is not a FontAwesome kit. Paste the kit id from your FontAwesome account, or the full https://kit.fontawesome.com/… URL.
styleEditor.iconStyleHint: Applies to every icon in the site and the admin panel. Needs a kit — all but Solid are Pro styles.
styleEditor.toastIconStyle: Icon style saved. Reload to see it.
styleEditor.iconStylePartial: ⚠ This is a stylised family, not a weight of the whole library. Icons it has no glyph for will not draw.

layoutEditor.title: Layout Editor
layoutEditor.subtitle: Compose what appears on each page. Blocks come from a fixed catalogue, so a layout is data — it can never run code. Changes stay in a draft until you publish.

blockDesc.section: A band across the page. Give it a background, a colour or padding, and put anything inside it.
blockDesc.columns: Side-by-side tracks. Add a column for each one — there is no count to set.
blockDesc.column: One track inside a columns row. Choose how wide it is, and whether it sticks while the page scrolls.
blockDesc.heading: A title. Pick its level so the page keeps a sensible outline.
blockDesc.eyebrow: A small label above a heading.
blockDesc.richText: Formatted text — links, lists and emphasis.
blockDesc.image: A picture, at the width you choose.
blockDesc.articleIndex: The list of published articles, as a grid or a list.
blockDesc.pluginSlot: Whatever your enabled plugins contribute here.
blockDesc.navbar: The site's navigation bar. Its own pieces live inside it.
blockDesc.header: The masthead band above the navigation — height, gradient and logo.
blockDesc.footer: The band at the foot of every page, and what sits in it.

layoutEditor.catalogueNote: Blocks come from a fixed catalogue, so a layout can never run code. Nothing goes live until you publish.
layoutEditor.catalogueRetry: Try a shorter word, or switch category.
layoutEditor.removeTreeTitle: Delete {{block}} and what is inside it?
layoutEditor.removeTreeBody: This also removes {{count}} block nested inside it.
layoutEditor.removeTreeBody_other: This also removes {{count}} blocks nested inside it.
layoutEditor.selectBlock: Select a block to edit its settings.
layoutEditor.audienceNobody: No groups selected — nobody will see this block.
layoutEditor.audienceNote: This controls whether the block is SHOWN, not what data is allowed. Anything that must stay private is enforced by the endpoint behind it.
layoutEditor.audienceRequired: This block is required on every page, so it is always visible. You can move it, but not limit who sees it.
layoutEditor.variantNote: A variant is a named look defined by the theme, not a colour on this block — every block set to the same variant stays in step, in both light and dark. Saved with the layout.
layoutEditor.classNameNote: An optional handle for your own CSS, e.g. nav-tile. Style through it — .nav-tile > * or .nav-tile img — since the handle itself paints nothing. Saved with the layout.
layoutEditor.variantLeaf: This block has no surface of its own. Set the style on the section or card that holds it, and this block follows it.
layoutEditor.variantTokenNote: These colours belong to the variant, so they change every block using it. They are staged in the appearance draft — publish under Style Editor.
layoutEditor.noBlocks: No blocks available for this template.
layoutEditor.wideHint: Designed for the body’s width — it will be cramped in the rail.
layoutEditor.aheadOfLive: Draft is ahead of the live site
layoutEditor.resetBody: The stored draft and published layout for this template are removed and the built-in default is restored. This cannot be undone.
layoutEditor.resetVariantBody: This page's own layout is removed and it goes back to using the shared default for all pages. This cannot be undone.
layoutEditor.discardBody: The unpublished changes to this layout are removed and the editor goes back to what is currently live. The published page is not affected.
layoutEditor.revertThemeTitle: Revert this page to the theme?
layoutEditor.revertThemeBody: Replaces your layout for this page with the one {{theme}} ships, as a draft you can preview before publishing. Your other pages are untouched.
layoutEditor.revertedTheme: Reverted to the theme layout — staged as a draft.
layoutEditor.conflictBody: Another tab or another admin saved this layout after you opened it. Autosave is paused until you choose. Reloading discards your unsaved changes; keeping yours overwrites theirs.
layoutEditor.variantDefaultNote: This is the fallback for pages you have not laid out individually — {{count}} page(s) right now. A page with its own layout is never changed by it.
layoutEditor.pageChromeHint: A page is a body and a rail beside it. The header and footer are their own templates, the same on every page — click one in the preview to arrange it.
layoutEditor.asideHint: Sits beside the body, and under it on a narrow screen.
layoutEditor.audienceViewHint: Filters the tree and the preview to one arrangement. Blocks you add are limited to it.
layoutEditor.bgInherits: Inherits the footer colours from the Style Editor
layoutEditor.bgOneStop: One colour paints a flat fill. Add a second for a gradient.
layoutEditor.bgNote: The image is drawn over the gradient, so either alone works. A colour written as var(--c-accent) follows the site's palette and both themes.
layoutEditor.chromeTabHint: Opens the site header or footer — its own layout, shown on every page.
layoutEditor.openPreview: Open the preview in a new tab
layoutEditor.deviceFill: Desktop — as wide as the canvas
layoutEditor.zoomHint: Fit the frame into the pane, or show it at full size.
layoutEditor.iconModeHint: Click any icon in the preview to change just that one.

groups.glowDesc: Adds a text-shadow to this group's usernames everywhere on the site.
groups.badgeLabelPlaceholder: Optional — defaults to the group name
groups.name: Name
groups.keyHintCreate: Unique identifier — cannot be changed after creation.
groups.showTeamDescCreate: Members of this group get their own section on the public Members → Team page (ordered by badge precedence).
groups.iconHintCreate: PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP · max 512 KB.
groups.keyHintEdit: Key is set at creation and cannot be changed.
groups.showTeamDescEdit: Members of this group get their own section on Members → Team (ordered by badge precedence).
groups.badgeColorHint: Used for the group badge and card accent color.
groups.iconHintEdit: PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP · max 512 KB. Shown on group cards and user profiles.
groups.progSub: Configure ladder placement, promotion thresholds and content limits.
groups.onLadderDesc: Users in this group can be auto-promoted
groups.ladderPosHint: Drag to reorder on the Progression page.
groups.deleteText: Members of “{{name}}” will be moved to the Member group.
groups.precedenceTitle: Badge precedence — lower ranks higher. Use the arrows to reorder.
groups.imageTypesNote: Leave all off for no per-rank restriction. Turning on GIF is what grants animated avatars and covers.

email.title: Email
email.subtitle: Configure the mail server and edit the messages this site sends. Changes save automatically.
email.subject: Subject
email.resetConfirm: The template goes back to the version shipped with Xentium. Your edits are discarded.
email.resetDone: Template reset to the shipped default.
email.smtpMissing: No SMTP host is configured, so nothing can be sent. Set one under Settings → Email.
email.smtpUnreachable: SMTP is configured but the connection failed: {{error}}

server.title: Server
server.desc: SMTP connection used for all outgoing mail.

email.templateDesc: Subject and body used when this message is sent.
email.bodyDesc: HTML. Values substituted into placeholders are escaped automatically.
email.testDesc: Delivers the SMTP test template to an address of your choice.

themes.title: Themes
themes.intro: A theme is data — layout documents, colours, custom CSS and images. It never contains code, so installing one cannot run anything.
themes.installedNone: No theme installed. The site is using its built-in look.
themes.installedNote: Importing an update keeps every page you have customised. Use “Revert to theme” in the Layout Editor to take the theme's version of one template.
themes.importHint: Accepts .xttheme and .xtstyle. The theme is applied as soon as it is installed; your own customised pages are kept.
themes.reportKept: {{count}} template(s) kept as you had them.
themes.reportCustomCss: The theme's custom CSS applied immediately — it has no draft.
themes.reportUnknownTemplates: Skipped, no plugin for them here: {{list}}
themes.reportUnknownBlocks: Blocks this site cannot render were kept in place: {{list}}
themes.reportStaged: The theme is live. Open the Layout Editor to fine-tune any page.
themes.exportHint: These become the theme's manifest. Only the marked fields are required.
themes.fieldDescriptionPlaceholder: What makes this theme different — shown to readers choosing it.
themes.fieldDescriptionHint: Up to 500 characters. Appears in the theme picker and in a marketplace listing.
themes.tokensOnlyHint: Export the palette without page layouts or images.
themes.fieldAppearanceHint: A site has one look. Say which one you built, so buyers can tell at a glance.
themes.ignoredFiles: Built for an older format — these parts were left out:
themes.fieldScreenshotHint: Packed into the theme as its screenshot and shown on marketplace listings. PNG, JPEG, WebP or AVIF.
themes.previewHint: Opens your site with this theme applied. It is already live for visitors — the library below is how you switch back.
themes.discardBody: Your pages and colours go back to how they were before this theme was installed — for visitors too. Any layout edits you have made since then will go back as well.
themes.discardHintNone: Undoing puts your own layouts back.
themes.libraryHint: Every theme installed here. Only one is active at a time, and switching applies the other one straight away.
themes.switchBody: {{name}} is installed. Put it on the site now, or keep {{current}}? You can switch at any time from Appearance → Themes.
themes.switchBodyStock: {{name}} is installed. Put it on the site now, or keep the default look? You can switch at any time from Appearance → Themes.
themes.keptInLibrary: {{name}} is in your theme library — the site is unchanged.
themes.reportInLibrary: {{name}} was added to your library. The site is unchanged until you switch to it.

owned.title: Your licences
owned.desc: Everything this marketplace account owns, and where each licence stands on this install.
owned.empty: This account doesn't own anything yet.
owned.unreachable: Couldn't reach the marketplace. Your installed plugins keep running — this list will fill in once it's back.
owned.emptyTitle: This account doesn't own anything yet

badges.title: Badges
badges.subtitle: What this site can award. Who holds what is on each member's page.
badges.fieldNameDesc: What the badge is called, on cards and in tooltips.
badges.fieldKeyDesc: Stable identifier. Cannot be changed after the badge is created.
badges.fieldDescriptionDesc: What the badge means. Shown when there is no reason on the award.
badges.fieldColorDesc: Tints the glyph and the ring around it.
badges.fieldOrderDesc: Lower sorts first, the same way group badges do.
badges.glyphHint: The mark this badge is drawn with, tinted by the colour above.
badges.rewardEmpty: No requirements set, so nobody can earn this yet.

groupNote.auto: Granted by the half-hourly sweep to anyone who meets every requirement.
groupNote.manual: You give these on a member's page. Nothing grants them on its own.

emptyNote.auto: Turn on the reward system inside a badge to have it granted on thresholds like articles or likes.
emptyNote.manual: Create one for the awards you want to decide yourself — a thank-you, a one-off, a staff pick.

badges.emptyFiltered: No badge here matches that search.
badges.drawerFoot: Awarding happens on a member's page — find the member and give the badge there. Taking one back here is immediate.
badges.deleteBody_one: One member holds it. Deleting the badge takes that award with it, and nothing here can put it back.
badges.deleteBody_other: {{count}} members hold it. Deleting the badge takes every one of those awards with it, and nothing here can put them back.

paneNote.details: What the badge is called and how it sorts. The key is what seeds and plugins name it by.
paneNote.appearance: A badge is a glyph in a tinted circle — this is the one place its look is decided.
paneNote.reward: Off, you hand this badge out yourself. On, the sweep grants it to anyone who qualifies.

badges.railNew: The key is locked once the badge is created — everything else stays editable.
badges.railHolders_one: One member holds this badge today.
badges.rewardOn: Granted by the sweep, and never taken away again.
badges.rewardOff: Leave it off and this badge is only ever given by an admin.
badges.requirementsNote: Every filled-in threshold must be met.
badges.footEdit: Changes apply the next time the badge is drawn.
badges.footNew: The key cannot be changed later.
badges.deleteBodyNone: Nobody holds it, so deleting it takes nothing with it. It cannot be undone.

iconPicker.needsKit: Styles need a FontAwesome kit. Set one in Branding.
iconPicker.partialFamily: ⚠ A stylised family — it does not cover every icon. Check the preview draws.
iconPicker.notBundled: Not one of the icons core ships. It needs the site's kit, and will not draw without one.
iconPicker.needsName: Choose an icon first — a style on its own has nothing to apply to.

composer.title: Composer
composer.subtitle: Which tools members get when they write, and where each one sits.
composer.toolsSub: {{count}} in the action bar. Everything else is one click away in the overflow tray.
composer.barEmpty: Nothing in the bar — members get the tray only.
composer.behaviourSub: How the composer acts on every surface.
composer.mentionsDesc: Typing @ suggests members in comments, threads, replies and private messages.
composer.notSupported: Attachments depend on the surface: the forum provides an upload path, article comments, the profile wall and private messages do not, so the paperclip is disabled there. There is no GIF service configured, so that picker is not offered at all.
